description: Boot briefing incorrectly surfaced 'Improving Movie Night' as tonight's event and listed David as organizer. Two distinct errors: (1) UTC-to-CT conversion failure — event start was 2026-06-25T22:00 UTC = 5:00 PM CT on June 25 (yesterday), not tonight. (2) Organizer misattribution — the calendar entry showed isOrganizer: true, but the organizer email was David.O'Hara@improving.com (apostrophe variant), which is a different account alias from David.OHara@improving.com. Should have flagged the ambiguity rather than asserting David organized the event.
what_was_wrong: Briefing said 'Improving Movie Night' was tonight and that David was the organizer.
what_was_right: It was last night (June 25), and David did not organize it.
proposed_fix: Add a UTC midnight-crossing check: any event with UTC start on date N that converts to CT date N-1 must be labeled as yesterday, not today. Also: when organizer email contains an apostrophe variant (O'Hara vs OHara), treat as ambiguous and do not assert isOrganizer without cross-checking the organizer field against David's known sending addresses.
